user.title: Electricity Bill
user.description: Configure electricity bill tracker and select source energy sensors.

error.no_sources: Please select at least one energy sensor.

abort.already_configured: Only one instance of Electricity Bill is allowed.

init.title: Electricity Bill Options
init.description: Update the main meter, energy sensors and fallback rate.

data.sources: Source Energy Sensors (sub-meters when a main meter is set)

data_description.main_meter: Whole-house energy sensor. When set, cycle energy and cost use this meter only and the sources below are only a breakdown.
data_description.reset_button: Button pressed automatically after you add a newer bill (e.g. the breaker Energy reset). Energy used since the bill date is kept.
data_description.sources: Sub-meters for the breakdown. Leave empty if you only have a main meter.

tariff.title: Tariff, billing day and budget
tariff.description: Optional. With a tariff profile the integration estimates the full bill (tiers, per-kWh adder such as Ft, fixed monthly charge, tax) and forecasts it to the next billing day. With "none" estimates use the effective rate of your last bill and nothing here is needed.

data.high_usage_factor: High daily usage alert (x the cycle average)

data_description.tariff_profile: none = estimate with the last bill's effective rate. thailand_residential = Thai PEA/MEA residential tiers (from the Sep 2026 bill). custom = your own tiers.
data_description.tariff_tiers: Format "200:3.0, 400:4.1584, 4.3583": cumulative upper limit in kWh and rate per kWh; the last tier is open-ended.
data_description.cutoff_day_30: Set the same day in all three fields if your billing day is fixed. Leave empty to disable the next-billing-day and forecast sensors.
data_description.budget_threshold: Fires the event electricity_bill_budget_exceeded once per cycle when the estimated bill reaches this amount.
data_description.high_usage_factor: Fires the event electricity_bill_high_usage once per day when today's energy reaches this multiple of the cycle's daily average (and at least 2 kWh). Leave empty to disable.

error.no_sources: Select a main meter or at least one energy sensor.
error.invalid_tiers: Invalid tiers. Use "limit:rate, limit:rate, rate" with increasing limits.

add_bill.name: Add Bill
add_bill.description: Record a monthly electricity bill, update unit rate, and reset cycle baseline.

period_start.name: Period Start Date
period_start.description: First day of the billing period (YYYY-MM-DD, optional).

period_end.name: Period End Date
period_end.description: Last day of the billing period the bill covers (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today).

kwh.name: Total kWh
kwh.description: Total energy in kWh from the bill.

ft_charge.name: Ft Charge
ft_charge.description: Fuel adjustment charge (Ft) in THB, may be negative (optional).

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Allow overwriting an existing bill with the same period end date.

remove_bill.name: Remove Bill
remove_bill.description: Remove a bill by ID or period end date.

id.name: Bill ID
id.description: UUID of the bill to remove.

period_end.name: Period End Date
period_end.description: Period end date of the bill to remove (YYYY-MM-DD).

reset_cycle.name: Reset Cycle
reset_cycle.description: Reset cycle baseline to current sensor states without recording a bill.

set_baseline.name: Set Baseline
set_baseline.description: Set the cycle baseline of one source sensor to a meter value (cycle energy = current value - baseline). Use 0 for a counter that started at 0.

value.name: Baseline value (kWh)
value.description: Meter value at the start of the cycle (default 0).

duplicate_period_end.message: A bill with period end {period_end} already exists. Pass replace: true to overwrite.

invalid_kwh.message: kWh must be greater than zero.

invalid_amount.message: Amount must be greater than zero.

invalid_date.message: Invalid date format for period_end. Expected YYYY-MM-DD.

invalid_period.message: Period start date must be before or equal to period end date.

invalid_charge.message: Charge amounts must be valid finite numbers and non-negative (except Ft).

bill_not_found.message: Bill with the specified ID or period end was not found.

missing_bill_identifier.message: Either id or period_end must be provided to remove a bill.

unknown_source.message: {entity_id} is not one of the configured source sensors.
